items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: until Jay gets back this is going to be Walter Brown and his band, under the direction of Gene Ramey.

ctx.x: Yeah. And comparing him with others. [Walter Brown] But somebody said he was born and raised in Dallas, Texas, and they say he died there. Somewhere near the same time that -- no, I think somebody said he died rather recently.
